source:
@@U03788@@
This—my hand.

@@U03790@@
Who would reproach our mistress
for showing this castle’s lord her loving favor?
We're captives, every one of us,
not once but many times
since the shameful fall of 特洛伊
and the dreaded labyrinthine trials
of our endless journey.
Women, accustomed to lovers,
may be experts,
but they can’t be choosers.
They take whatever opportunity offers,
giving their voluptuous limbs alike
to golden-haired shepherd boys and
bristly, black fauns.
Look, they're already drawing closer,
leaning together, shoulder to shoulder,
knee to knee, hand in hand as they
rock to and fro on the grandly cushioned throne,
unashamed of displaying their Majesty's secret affections
to the sight of their people.

@@U03792@@
I feel so far away, and yet so near;
What joy it is to say: I’m here, I’m here!

@@U03794@@
My breath is short, my words no longer free;
It’s all a dream; time, place have ceased to be.

@@U03796@@
I seem to be long past, and yet so new;
Bound fast with you and to a stranger true.
translation:
@@U03788@@
这——我的手。

@@U03790@@
谁会辱骂我们的女主人
为了向这座城堡的领主表达她的爱意？
我们每个人都是俘虏
不是一次而是很多次
自从特洛伊可耻倒台以来
以及可怕的迷宫般的考验
我们无尽的旅程。
女人，习惯了恋人，
可能是专家，
但他们不能成为选择者。
他们抓住一切机会，
给予他们同样性感的四肢
到金色头发的牧童和
毛茸茸的黑色牧神。
看，他们已经靠近了，
肩并肩，靠在一起，
膝对膝，手拉着手
在豪华的坐垫宝座上来回摇晃，
毫不羞耻地表达陛下的秘密感情
到他们人民的眼前。

@@U03792@@
我感觉距离很远，又很近；
说：我在这里，我在这里，这是多么令人高兴啊！

@@U03794@@
我的呼吸急促，我的言语不再自由；
一切都是梦；时间、地点都已不复存在。

@@U03796@@
我似乎已经过去很久了，却又如此新鲜；
与你和陌生人紧密相连。
